deep.reconstruction:
The page is a working sheet on the genus-3 case of Abelian/theta functions. It deals with the plane quartic, its 28 bitangents (the odd theta characteristics) and the 36 even characteristics. This is the material of Riemann's posthumous 1866 note 'Zur Theorie der Abel'schen Functionen für den Fall p=3', edited by H. Weber.

(A) Top left: the quartic in Riemann's normal form.
- He writes sqrt(x*xi) + sqrt(y*eta) + sqrt(z*zeta) = 0 with xi = alpha x + beta y + gamma z, eta = alpha' x + beta' y + gamma' z, zeta = alpha'' x + beta'' y + gamma'' z.
- My rationalisation: (x xi + y eta - z zeta)^2 = 4 x y xi eta, a quartic.
- Restricting to x = 0 gives (y eta - z zeta)^2 = 0. So x = 0 meets the curve in two double points, i.e. it is a bitangent. Likewise y, z, xi, eta, zeta give six bitangents.
- He writes y(b'y + c'z) + z(b''y + c''z) [reading uncertain] and then (y/z)_{x=0} = -c''/b''. The latter is the point where zeta = 0 meets x = 0, the intersection of two bitangent lines.

(B) Left column: symbolic characteristics.
- Characteristics are written as formal sums of basic symbols n, p, q, r, ϑ, ε, f (Riemann's 'Systeme'). They are added mod 2: a symbol occurring twice cancels.
- Lists such as n+p, n+q, n+r / n+q+r, n+p+r, n+p+q / ϑ, ϑ+p, ϑ+q, ϑ+r enumerate characteristics.
- Bracket expressions (ϑ, n+q+r, n+p+r) = (ϑ+p, n+p, n+p+r) and (ϑ n+p n+q)(n+q+r n+r) = (ϑ+p, n+r)(ϑ+p n+q+r n+q) relate triples or products of triples whose total sums agree.
- In my reading these are relations among products of theta functions (or of bitangent forms) with given characteristics, checked by comparing sums mod 2.
- The block (ϑ+p)+p+q = (q+r)+ϑ+r etc. verifies that the pair {ϑ+p, q+r} combined with pairs from {ϑ, p, q, r} gives equal sums mod 2:
  - ϑ+q = ϑ+q
  - p+q = p+q
  - ϑ+r = ϑ+r
  - p+r = p+r

(C) Determinant identities.
- He sets up p, q, r, p', q', r' with p+p'+q+q'+r+r' = (0).
- He writes three-term relations (r,r,r')(r',r,r') = (r',p,p')(r,q,q') + (q,p,p')(r',r,r') + (q',p,p')(r',q,r) and (q,p,p')(q',r,r') + (q',p,p')(q,r,r') = 0. Some symbols are probably misread.
- On the right this is made explicit as 123.456 = 126.453 + 163.452 + 623.451. With [ijk] a 3x3 determinant of vectors i, j, k, this is the three-term Grassmann–Plücker relation.
- Proof (mine): by Cramer, [123] v6 = [623] v1 + [163] v2 + [126] v3. Taking the determinant with v4, v5 gives the identity.
- The bottom-right lines (p linear forms a^k_1 x_1 + ... + a^k_{p+1} x_{p+1} in p+1 unknowns, with a_2 = a_1') set up the general linear-elimination / Cramer framework for this.

(D) Counting.
- 28*27*10/(1*2*3) = 1260 and 28*27*16/(1*2*3) = 2016. These are the numbers of syzygetic and azygetic triples of bitangents (26 = 10 + 16 for a fixed pair; total C(28,3) = 3276).
- 8*5*6*7/(1*2*3) = 280.
- 36*8*5*6*7/(28*27*16) = 10080/2016 = 5.
- 36*35/(2*7*9) = 1260/126 = 10.
- 36*35*16/(1*2*3) = 3360.
- Also 20, 15, 16 appear.
- The parity remarks: 'p+q+r gerade, n gerade und auch n+p+q+r; n+p+q, n+q+r, n+p+r ungerade', and (p,q,r) = 0 when a certain theta vanishes. These fix which symbolic sums are even and which odd.
- The long brackets (n+ϑ+ε+f, n+p+q+f, n, n+p+q+r+ϑ, n+p+q+r+ε) list systems of characteristics used in the count (36 choices times configurations).
errors: Machine reading of (ϑ+p)+q+r / (q+r)+ϑ+q is inconsistent mod 2 (gives ϑ+p+q+r vs ϑ+r). The image most likely reads (ϑ+p)+p+r, giving ϑ+r on both sides. With that reading all four lines are correct.

The y(b'y+c'z)+z(b''y+c''z) line is not literally the restriction of the rationalised quartic to x=0; that restriction is (y eta - z zeta)^2 = 0. The value (y/z) = -c''/b'' is the intersection of x=0 with zeta=0. The reading is uncertain, so no definite error can be asserted.
Several symbols in the bracket relations of section (C) are doubtful in the transcription, e.g. (r,r,r'). Their correctness cannot be checked as read.
No arithmetic slips: all displayed binomial-type counts evaluate consistently (1260, 2016, 280, 5, 10, 3360).

results.what: Quartic in the form sqrt(x xi)+sqrt(y eta)+sqrt(z zeta)=0 with six bitangents x,y,z,xi,eta,zeta
results.modern_name: Riemann's normal form of a plane quartic via an Aronhold-type set of bitangents
results.usually_credited_to: Riemann (1866 posthumous note, ed. Weber 1876); related to Hesse/Aronhold

results.what: Counts 1260 and 2016 of syzygetic/azygetic bitangent triples; 36 even characteristics; ratios 5 and 10
results.modern_name: Combinatorics of theta characteristics in genus 3 (syzygetic/azygetic triples, Steiner complexes)
results.usually_credited_to: Steiner, Hesse (1855), Cayley; theta-characteristic version Riemann/Weber

results.what: Mod-2 calculus of characteristics as sums of basic symbols, with parity rules
results.modern_name: Arithmetic of theta characteristics in (Z/2)^{2g} with the quadratic (parity) form

deep.surprise_reason: This is scratch work for Riemann's known genus-3 note (published posthumously via Weber): bitangents, characteristic arithmetic, classical counts and a standard determinant identity. Nothing goes beyond what is already attributed to him or was classical.

checkable.sympy: x,y,z,a,b,c,a1,b1,c1,a2,b2,c2=symbols('x y z a b c a1 b1 c1 a2 b2 c2'); xi=a*x+b*y+c*z; eta=a1*x+b1*y+c1*z; zeta=a2*x+b2*y+c2*z; F=(x*xi+y*eta-z*zeta)**2-4*x*y*xi*eta; factor(F.subs(x,0))
checkable.asserts: restriction to x=0 is a perfect square (y*eta - z*zeta)^2, so x=0 is a bitangent

transcription_corrections: '(ϑ+p)+q+r  (q+r)+ϑ+q' should probably read '(ϑ+p)+p+r  (q+r)+ϑ+q' so that both sides equal ϑ+r.
'(ϑ+p)+ϑ+q' in line 1 of that block appears as '(ϑ+p)+p+q' in the image (giving ϑ+q = (q+r)+ϑ+r); line 2 is (ϑ+p)+ϑ+q.
First-line second term: y(β'y+γ'z) rather than y(b''y+c''z) is likely; primes uncertain.
Bottom-right entries are coefficients a^k_i of p linear forms in x_1..x_{p+1}, with a_2 = a_1' read as a coefficient identification.
